findings.reason: MFA-authorized evidence read only appends access-log metadata; domain report, inquiry and related state stay unchanged. Incidental access logging is safe under RFC 9110 section 9.2.1.

Provider callback GET requires unpredictable browser-bound state, exact provider and expiry, consumed atomically before exchange/session issuance. PKCE protects exchange; concurrent, later and failed-exchange replay cannot reuse state. Rejected callbacks preserve the pending browser binding.
